text.description_html:
First Impressions CF-AW-Mahogany-US15 Wood Door Handle with Satin Nickel Finished Solid Brass Standoffs

Hand made in the USA by the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International.

The Mahogany wood handle is unstained in its natural color. Great door pull handle for commercial doors or residential doors.

Specifications for First Impressions CF-AW-Mahogany-US15 Contemporary Wood Door Handle

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Center to Center: 12"
  • Back to Back Mounting
  • Total Length: 36"
  • Pull Handle Material: Solid Mahogany
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Pull Bracket Finish: Satin Nickel

Note: This Mahogany wood door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with Back to Back mounting

*Sold As A Pair
